import math
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from subject import compute_freshness_score


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_zero_days():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)
    created_at = now
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    assert score == 1.0


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_one_week():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 8, 12, 0, 0)
    created_at = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    expected = math.exp(-0.015 * 7)
    assert abs(score - expected) < 1e-9


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_four_weeks():
    now = datetime(2025, 2, 5, 12, 0, 0)
    created_at = datetime(2025, 1, 8, 12, 0, 0)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    expected = math.exp(-0.015 * 28)
    assert abs(score - expected) < 1e-9


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_future_created_at():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)
    created_at = datetime(2025, 1, 2, 12, 0, 0)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    assert score == 1.0


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_large_days():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    created_at = datetime(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    days_old = (now - created_at).total_seconds() / 86400
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    expected = math.exp(-0.015 * days_old)
    assert abs(score - expected) < 1e-9


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_monotonic_decay():
    base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    scores = []
    for days in [0, 1, 7, 30, 365]:
        created_at = base - timedelta(days=days)
        scores.append(compute_freshness_score(created_at, base))
    for i in range(len(scores) - 1):
        assert scores[i] >= scores[i + 1]


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_half_life_approx():
    # e^(-0.015 * t) = 0.5 => t = ln(2)/0.015 ≈ 46.21 days
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    half_life_days = math.log(2) / 0.015
    created_at = now - timedelta(days=half_life_days)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    assert abs(score - 0.5) < 1e-9


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_returns_float():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    created_at = now - timedelta(days=10)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    assert isinstance(score, float)
